ZERO FREE PARAMETERS and zero new ScenarioConfig surface: all four numbers were already committed before the session opened, nothing was swept, blended or tuned, no residual was consulted, and the DOF ledger is carried VERBATIM at 11 entries / 9 residual, ASSERTED by scripts/gen_caiso163_attestation.py rather than assumed. Path 15 becomes a path that binds at all -- NP15 separates from ZP26 in 237 / 414 / 284 hours, up from 3 / 0 / 1, and the 2024 NP15==ZP26 byte-identity is broken. NO ZERO-DELTA YEAR EXISTS for this mechanism (the published ratings are year-invariant, so every solve year is live), so the prereg replaced it with a PRE-SOLVE STRUCTURAL ASSERTION, run and passing before either arm solved: with the flag off, apply_caiso_asymmetric_path_limits returns the SAME OBJECT (identity, not equality), so the off path cannot perturb the topology even by reconstruction -- that is what licenses arm A as a clean control. PRICE EFFECT, stated plainly rather than leaned on: load-weighted lambda -0.0036% (2023), -0.0147% (2024), +0.0102% (2025) of level, with ZERO criterion flips on all nine criteria against the same-HEAD control. disposition_note: DETERMINATION CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, CARRIED OVER UNCHANGED from the caiso-162 keeper: the same 2 of 3 non-protective ledgered slots (C3c-2023/24 and C3a-2025, both the OWNER's act of 2026-07-30 at caiso-145), protective 0 of 1, 0 FAILs. NO NEW CAVEAT SLOT IS SPENT -- installing published directional ratings with zero free parameters creates no caveat. ALL NINE CRITERIA ARE IDENTICAL BETWEEN THE CONTROL AND THIS KEEPER: C1, C2, C3b PASS; C4 PASS; protective C6, C7, C8 PASS; C3a-2025 unchanged at +12.0%; C3c-2023/24 unchanged. Zero flips in either direction. THIS KEEPER OPENS A ROOT-CAUSE ISSUE RATHER THAN CLOSING ONE, AND SAYS SO RATHER THAN BURYING IT. Installing the published ratings makes Path 15 bind for the first time, but in only 2.7% / 4.7% / 3.2% of hours, whereas the REAL Path 15 separates NP15 from ZP26 in ~100% of hours and carries a mean NP15-over-ZP26 basis of +5.95 / +8.58 / +5.73 $/MWh against this keeper's -0.077 / -0.109 / -0.084; the NP15-over-SP15 basis likewise moves marginally FURTHER from the measured +2.34 / +7.99 / +6.01 (the Path-15 N->S tightening leg dominates the Path-26 S->N leg, trapping cheap northern energy in NP15). PRECHECK section 3 registered BEFORE the solve that the two legs push the ISO mean in OPPOSITE directions and predicted NO sign, so this is a resolved ambiguity, not a surprise. Under rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] and rule 1 [R-STRUCT] a marginally worse basis under a PUBLISHED limit is a DISCOVERED BUG, not a reason to restore the estimate: the symmetric TTC was silently absorbing a defect that lives elsewhere, most plausibly in the reduced two-link N-S topology and zonal aggregation, which cannot reproduce hourly Path-15 congestion whatever the ratings are. That investigation is OPEN and is NOT claimed as closed; no compensating adder, haircut or offset was added to hide it (rules 1/13). THIS IS NOT A C3a ARM and must not be reported as one -- C3a-2025 is unchanged at +12.0% and the level effect is nil. THE FOUR OWNER-DECISION DEFAULT FLIPS (retirement_rule -> pipeline, entry_rate_limits + entry_commissioning_lag armed, net_cone_forward_escalation -> reindex_gross; D-1 / D-2 / D-3a) were already carried by the incumbent, so they do not even appear as a config drift here -- the drift against BOTH the incumbent and the control is EXACTLY ONE FIELD, caiso_asymmetric_path_ratings, with zero schema drift. They are asserted anyway on the same two grounds: forecast-gated capacity-evolution machinery unreachable at mode='backcast', and identical across both arms. gen_caiso163_attestation.py FAILS if either condition breaks, if any undeclared delta appears against either comparator, if the DOF ledger moves, if the control never exceeded a published rating (which would make the mechanism INERT), or if any treatment hour exceeds one. RULE 22 leave-one-year-out: this session fits NOTHING and moves no free parameter, so LOYO reduces to the no-held-out-degradation check -- all three years show the same structural improvement and no criterion flips in any year, so no single year carries the result. CAISO still holds NO rule-22 calibration-complete marker, so every out-of-training year (2022, 2019, <=2021, H1-2026) stays fully quarantined; the holdout spend freeze is ACTIVE and outranks every marker. This session solved 2023/2024/2025 only (rule 16) and wrote no marker. THE STANDING DATA BLOCKERS ARE UNCHANGED and are not closable by an adder, haircut or residual-tuned value: C3a-2025 needs non-public hourly pumped-storage data and C3c-2023/24 needs the SoCalGas OFO declaration record, absent from data/raw.
